description: Zendrop helps ecommerce merchants manage dropshipping operations from ChatGPT. Users can search the Zendrop catalog, add and import products to connected stores, inspect store, order, billing, and performance data, update fulfillment and tracking settings, preview fulfillment costs, and confirm guarded order fulfillment, cancellation, address, and product-linking workflows.
